vocabularyNote: 学术词、主题术语和常用搭配；提供词典释义与原文例句。多义词需结合例句辨义。

vocabulary.zh:

England’s previous strategy for public libraries covered the period from 2016 to 2021, while the legislation underpinning the service dates from 1964. parts.text: These ambitions are not misplaced. Public libraries are trusted local institutions with an impressive record of

to changing social needs. If libraries can help people access healthcare, develop digital skills and connect with public services, that should be celebrated.

The NHS App partnership

both the opportunity and the challenge. NHS England is right to recognise that libraries are spaces where people can receive help accessing digital health services and reliable health information. It is exactly the kind of partnership that demonstrates their continuing relevance. But partnerships like these rely on

staff, welcoming buildings, up-to-date collections and sustainable services. Libraries’ resilience has often masked the cumulative effects of sustained underinvestment.

What’s more, public libraries are entering one of the most significant periods of change in decades. Local government
is an ongoing process of replacing existing county and district councils with new unitary authorities. It has the potential to

many library authorities across England as councils continue to deal with the legacy of long-term financial pressures.

In September, the reorganisation was halted while the government carries out a review, including reconsidering decisions already made in some areas. This leaves libraries

services for their communities while simultaneously planning for structural changes, which may or may not happen.

What libraries need

The question, then, is whether the forthcoming strategy will focus on

libraries and their core offer or simply continue to expand what libraries are expected to do for others. The capacity of libraries to support wider government priorities depends on the health of the library service itself.

Our recent research shows why this matters. Physical collections – books,
, graphic novels, audiobooks on CD – continue to shrink while investment in new stock remains persistently low across many library services. Physical items that libraries loan are not an

extra. They remain fundamental to reading for pleasure, literacy, lifelong learning, access to information and the distinctive identity of the public library itself.

to health, education and economic growth without addressing the condition of their core functions risks treating symptoms rather than causes.

reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: Science curricula often overlook women whose work helped shape scientific knowledge.
School recess supports children's development in ways that extend beyond entertainment.
Better preparation for teachers is central to supporting pupils with dyslexia.
Public libraries support communities in many ways and need resources to sustain that work.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: Asking libraries to do more for their communities must go hand in hand with strengthening the collections, workforce and financial support that allow them to do it.

questions.prompt: From which year does the legislation underpinning England's public-library service date?
questions.explanation: 第 3 段提供了作答依据。正确选项用不同说法表达了文中的信息；请比较范围、数量、因果关系与限定词。
questions.evidence: England’s previous strategy for public libraries covered the period from 2016 to 2021, while the legislation underpinning the service dates from 1964.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is explicitly made in paragraph 7?
options: Asking libraries to do more for their communities must go hand in hand with strengthening the collections, workforce and financial support that allow them to do it.
